datasets.summary: GEO now links PMID 42239780 (Research Square preprint, PMC13228855). The methods define DEGs as P<0.05 and log2FC>0.2 (DESeq2 median-of-ratios) and say the DESeq2 statistics fed heatmaps and volcano plots, but no machine-readable gene-statistics table is listed. The normalized-count files are expression inputs. Their headers were inspected in the earlier review; they were not re-parsed here. Sources searched: GEO SOFT and suppl list (two DESeq2 normalized-count tabular files, CP and HT); PMC10529429 full-text XML supplement inventory (single NIHMS supplement PDF) and methods; data-availability text (GEO only). The Europe PMC fullTextXML endpoint returned an HTTP 500 JSON error, so the NCBI efetch XML was used instead.

A matching primary preprint was newly identified: bioRxiv 10.1101/2024.05.23.595504 (v2 title: "Human hypothalamic neural stem cells transplantation ameliorates age-associated dysfunction through SNS/eNAMPT axis activation in aged mice"). Its data availability statement names GSE214877. The bulk RNA-seq was used to cluster htNSCs with GTEx adult brain regions, and DESeq2 is named for DEG calling. No hPSC-versus-htNSC gene table was found in the main text or the supplemental PDF; the supplement has only reagent and primer tables. The "Supporting Data Values XLS" named in the text is not in the bioRxiv supplement listing. Not located. Sources searched: GEO SOFT, PubMed (no indexed article), web search, bioRxiv API, the v2 JATS full text and the v2 supplemental PDF text.
